items.difficulty_reason: Counted unit is Lemma 9.1.9 at source lines 167-173: for paths p : a = a', q : b = b' and a morphism f : hom_A(a,b), the transport of f along (p,q) equals the conjugate idtoiso(q) o f o inv(idtoiso(p)). The author's proof (source lines 174-178) is a short computation, but both sides must be evaluated: the left-hand side collapses to f under path induction (line 176), and the right-hand side requires knowing that idtoiso at a reflexivity is the identity morphism, after which the unit laws of the precategory finish the identification (line 177). The statement is an equation between a transport and a composite and records neither the induction nor the evaluation of idtoiso.
